description: Send a bug or an idea to the TrainRec team, only after the person agrees to. Call find_issues first: if an issue matches, pass its issueId with what this person adds; otherwise pass kind, title and details for a new one. Say what happened and where in the app, never anything about their health beyond what the bug needs.

details.description: What happened, where in the app, and what they expected; or, with issueId, what this person adds.

title.description: A new issue: one plain line, like "Rest timer does not show on the watch".

name: trainrec_report_issue
title: Report a bug or idea
